class.name: SteamPublisherPurchaseOrder
class.brief_description: Immutable priced order and its durable progress.
class.description: Trusted stores persist and rehydrate this value for the exact AppID, environment, Steam account and checkout. Use [method with_progress] to restore a stored revision. The publisher verifies every applicable Steam receipt before using it to grant or reverse entitlement.

method.name: create
method.description: Returns a new [constant RESERVED] order at revision zero, or null for an invalid configuration, duplicate SKU or item ID, empty or oversized cart, or total overflow.

method.name: with_progress
method.description: Returns a copy of the quote with the supplied durable state. Returns null for an invalid revision, phase, transaction ID, timestamp, or reversed item set. This constructs a storage snapshot and does not request a payment or grant an entitlement.

method.name: get_app_id
method.description: Positive Steamworks AppID for the original order.

method.name: get_environment
method.description: Steam endpoint environment selected for the original order.

method.name: get_order_id
method.description: Canonical positive decimal order ID assigned by the publisher.

method.name: get_steam_id
method.description: Canonical decimal SteamID64 of the authenticated buyer.

method.name: get_checkout_id
method.description: Stable account-scoped retry ID encoded as 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

method.name: get_language
method.description: Lowercase ISO 639-1 language code used in the checkout.

method.name: get_lines
method.description: Read-only list of up to 32 unique priced lines.

method.name: get_total
method.description: Checked sum of the quoted line totals, in the original currency's Steam units.

method.name: get_tax_basis
method.description: Basis used when verifying a receipt's line amount. Defaults to [constant NET].

method.name: get_revision
method.description: Optimistic concurrency revision. The reservation begins at zero.

method.name: get_transaction_id
method.description: Valve's canonical decimal transaction ID, empty before it is known.

method.name: get_vendor_updated_at
method.description: Latest accepted Steam UTC timestamp in Unix seconds, or zero before an observation.

method.name: get_reversed_item_ids
method.description: Exact Steam item IDs whose entitlements have been reversed for this order.
